result.title: Minimum credit score filter includes borrowers at exactly the threshold
result.description: Regression guard for BUG-6: server/routes.js:47 used `creditScore > minScore` instead of `>=`, dropping applicants who exactly meet the policy threshold.
result.preconditions: App running at http://localhost:3000 with default seed data. Two borrowers have a credit score of exactly 700: Patricia Garcia and Joseph Gonzalez.

steps.expected_result: The table renders with the first page of results

steps.action: Enter `700` in the **Minimum credit score** field
steps.expected_result: Every row shows a credit score of 700 or higher

steps.action: Look for the row for **Patricia Garcia**
steps.expected_result: Her row is visible and shows a credit score of `700`
